dc:title: Google review replies and removal: a time-order and rounding audit — google-reply-cohorts.csv

columns.name: record_type
columns.dc:description: Distinguishes attributed source aggregates from conditional mathematical cells.

columns.name: source_review_count
columns.dc:description: Publisher count in a selected deleted-review row, not all posted reviews.

columns.name: source_median_lifespan_days
columns.dc:description: Publisher creation-to-removal median, not report turnaround time.

columns.name: source_removed_within_7_days_percent
columns.dc:description: Source percentage within the selected deleted-review group.

columns.name: model_reply_lower_seconds
columns.dc:description: Inclusive model lower bound derived from a source label; unverified raw-time bin convention.

columns.name: model_reply_upper_exclusive_seconds
columns.dc:description: Exclusive model upper bound; blank for unbounded or no-reply groups.

columns.name: conditional_7_day_count_min
columns.dc:description: Smallest integer compatible with the explicitly assumed nearest-tenth percentage rounding. Not an observed event count.

columns.name: conditional_7_day_count_max
columns.dc:description: Largest integer compatible with the explicitly assumed rounding. A 0.0% display does not alone prove zero events.
